parts.notes: M1 for change of base (log_4 = (1/2)log_2) or equivalent. A1 for 2log_2(x-3)=log_2(x+9). M1 for equating arguments: (x-3)^2=x+9. A1 for x^2-7x=0. A1 for x=0 or x=7. R1 for rejecting x=0 using domain x>3. A1 for x=7.

parts.label: a_i
parts.notes: M1 for setting up common ratio equation p = 1/(3p) or equivalent. A1 for p^2 = 1/3. AG.

parts.label: a_ii
parts.description: Find x given p = 1/sqrt(3) and S_infinity = 3 + sqrt(3)
parts.notes: M1 for applying S_infinity = a/(1-r). A1 for ln(x) = 2 or equivalent. A1 for x = e^2.

parts.label: b_i
parts.notes: M1 for equal-difference setup: p ln x - ln x = (1/3)ln x - p ln x. A1 for 2p = 4/3. AG.

parts.label: b_ii
parts.description: Write d in form k ln x

parts.label: b_iii
parts.description: Find n such that S_n = -3 ln x
parts.notes: M1 for applying S_n = (n/2)[2a + (n-1)d]. A1 for substituting a = ln x and d = -(1/3)ln x. A1 for simplified S_n = n(7-n)ln(x)/6. M1 for setting equal to -3ln x and dividing by ln x. A1 for n^2 - 7n - 18 = 0. A1 for factored form (n-9)(n+2)=0. A1 for n=9, rejecting n=-2.
parts.follow_through: If candidate's d from (b)(ii) is wrong but they correctly apply S_n formula, award M1 A1 M1 for the method.
